lemmas.closure_argument: The A7 exposure model assumed any unadjudicated holiday manifests as a TRUNCATED session (every committed truncation time is <= 12:15 CT, so a truncated day cannot reach 234 bars) or a CLOSURE (no session). Both arms hold in the data. The model missed a third case, materialized exactly once: 2015-07-02, where the committed official schedule (2015-4th-of-july-holiday-schedule.pdf, 'CME Group Equity Products': 'Thursday, July 2: 1215 CT - Early close') conflicts with the committed panel (complete 390-bar session, real volume 476,608 contracts after 12:00 CT). The freeze has no class for that date, so the session is eval-eligible with holiday status that is simultaneously adjudicated-by-artifact (early close) and contradicted-by-data (full session) — unresolvable by this lane under the fail-closed law. Verdict: NOT_RUN (blocker) with the named date.
